_comment: Voxy amp slot specs — used by the ranker to score each tube per slot (0–5 stars). See tubehunter.py score_for_slot() for how these fields feed the scoring rubric. Edit freely.

amp.name: Voxy
amp.topology: single-ended, ~4 W, AC4-inspired (push-pull optional if V2p_B is populated)

heater_supply.existing_rails_note: EF94 uses 6.3 V, PCL86 uses 13 V. A tube whose heater matches either of these joins an existing rail and doesn't cost a new one; anything else at ≤37 V requires a third rail (still fine — the max is three).

amp.opt: Hammond 1750C SE (~5k primary) — SE only; push-pull would need a different OPT

V1.label: V1 · Pentode preamp
V1.role: Front-end pentode voltage gain into HOWL pot
V1.notes: Runs off B+3 through 100k plate R; 470k screen feed intentionally starves for headroom. Remote-cutoff pentodes distort audio — avoid. EF86 is a rewire (noval socket) but the sonic prize.

V2t.label: V2 triode · Boost
V2t.role: Triode section drives the cold-clip / SIZZLE. Currently the PCL86 triode.
V2t.notes: Standalone triode preamp fits if you split the PCL86 into two envelopes. 12AX7 family = drop-in socket; heater rail is buck-boost so 12.6 V is fine.

V2p.label: V2 pentode · SE output
V2p.role: SE power pentode into 1750C. ~5 W plate dissipation target at 305 V.
V2p.notes: SE class-A into ~5k primary favors EL84/6BQ5-class. 6V6 fits electrically but octal (different socket). >15W diss is overkill and wastes heater budget.

combo.label: Combo · full V2 drop-in
combo.role: Triode preamp + SE power pentode in one envelope — direct PCL86 replacement.
combo.notes: 13 V heater = joins the PCL86 rail. 6.3 V variants (ECL82/86, 6BM8, 6GW8) work fine but sit on the EF94 rail instead.

PI.label: PI · Cathodyne phase inverter
PI.role: OPTIONAL — one triode section as a split-load (cathodyne) PI. Sends anti-phase signal to a push-pull output pair.
PI.notes: Cathodyne gain ≈ 1; low-µ triodes (12AU7, 6SN7) give the cleanest split. High-µ (12AX7) works and is the Fender Champ/Princeton PI, but with less headroom. Only relevant if you're building the push-pull option.

V2p_B.label: V2 · PP second power valve
V2p_B.role: OPTIONAL — second power tube for push-pull output (replaces SE with PP; needs a PP OPT swap).
V2p_B.notes: Same tube type as V2p. Look for in-stock so a matched pair is available. Uses same heater rail as V2p — no extra rail cost when both output tubes match.
